unknown_identity_policy: index 0 is explicit unknown; historical source unknown judge identities are not learned as ordinary identities; identities first appearing on or after the vocab cutoff also map to unknown
clean_control_embedding_policy: compact dataset-matched maps only: unknown=0 and embedding input dimension=max(index)+1
dev3_change_reason: dev2 anchored Open Class rows to the World Class reference curve at their own division rank (championship-week WC values sit 15-20 points above OC scores) and left first-ever-appearance corps with an all-zero baseline anchor, producing +15pt zero-history errors. dev3 makes the as-of reference curve division-keyed (division x rank x percent-bucket x caption, both model divisions, nearest-same-division fallback) and the trainer substitutes the rank-curve forecast baseline whenever the stored global baseline is all-zero. Reference baselines, residual targets, and rank-baseline statics change for Open Class rows; identity vocabulary and dimensions are unchanged from dev2.
